info.description: API documentation for the Laravel REST API Starter Kit repository.

get.summary: Display a paginated list of activity logs

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Maximum 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sorts. Prefix with `-` for descending order. Allowed values: `id`, `created_at`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationships to eager load. Allowed values: `causer`, `subject`.

parameters.name: fields[activities]
parameters.description: Select fields to fetch for `activities`. Allowed values: `id`, `log_name`, `description`, `event`, `subject_type`, `subject_id`, `causer_type`, `causer_id`, `properties`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: Export query results directly as an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx).

200.description: Successful list retrieval or spreadsheet file export
